t01.description: Conditional probability is the joint distribution divided by the marginal of the condition.
Under independence, conditioning on Y adds no information about X.

t03.description: The joint can be decomposed in either variable order using a conditional and a marginal.
The product or chain rule generalizes to arbitrarily many variables.
